meta_title: Mercury Group — executive transportation & airport transfers
meta_desc: Airport transfers, business and intercity trips in a Mercedes-Benz S-Class, V-Class or BMW 7. Book online: addresses, date and time.
hero_p: Airport meet & greet, city rides and intercity trips in a Mercedes-Benz S-Class, V-Class or BMW 7. Tell us the addresses, date and time — we’ll take care of the rest.
map_aria: Map: route from the airport to the client’s address
book_p: Fill in the form and we’ll call you back to confirm your ride. Or contact us directly:
globe_aria: Globe: a plane flies from one point to another
err: We couldn’t send your request. Please call us:
consent: By sending the request you agree to the processing of your contact details so we can reach you about the booking.
ok_p: Thank you! We’ll contact you shortly to confirm your ride.
sv_p: From meet & greet at arrivals to an out-of-town trip: one call or one request.
sv1_p: Meet & greet in arrivals, help with luggage and flight-delay tracking.
sv2_p: Meetings, negotiations, hosting partners — with hourly hire.
sv3_p: Weddings, celebrations and receptions — a single car or a whole motorcade.
sv4_p: A comfortable ride to another city or country, with no changes.
v_p: Room for a family, delegation or group with luggage — with the same level of comfort.
b_p: An executive sedan with character: rear-seat comfort and confident performance.
s_p: A quiet cabin and a smooth ride for business meetings and private transfers.
st1_p: Enter the addresses, date and time in the booking form.
st2_p: We contact you to confirm the details and price.
st3_p: Your car arrives exactly on time.
